title: maxPaidAttempts of 1 exhausts on the first re-challenge
description: The boundary that separates a disposition table from a loop guard. With maxPaidAttempts set to 1 there is no second pass for a guard to prevent, so an implementation that decided exhaustion by falling out of a loop would have nowhere to raise the error and would report the bare 402 instead. The bound belongs to the 402 branch: attempt 1 is already the last permitted attempt.
